# Transcript to PDF for YouTube

MV3 extension v1.0.1; Chrome 116+. Exports captions locally through Download PDF, Print and Copy. [src: manifest.json; README.md]

The worker tries direct caption downloads, then an injected transcript-panel reader. Direct fetches omit credentials; a normal panel tab can use its existing session. Panel language is unverified; explicit language selection requires a direct download. [src: src/background/service-worker.js]

The PDF writer uses Latin-1; Print preserves Unicode through Chrome. Pure modules under src/lib/ use no chrome.* APIs. [src: src/lib/pdf.js; docs/COMPONENTS.md]

Node >=22; no npm dependencies. Run npm run check and npm run build. Optional image tooling uses Python and Pillow. [src: package.json; docs/DEVELOPMENT.md]
